The good phone and the bad battery. I am a Moto fan for a few years. I bought 2 Moto G6 on prime day to replace Moto E4 and Moto E4 Plus. I bought a black Moto G6 and Oyster Blush Moto G6 for my wife. After spending one day with the black Moto G6, my battery drained to 15% in 10 hours. I had about 87% 6am and %15 at 4pm. It was a normal day use like I always do with my previous Moto E4 Plus. I ordered a replacement and Amazon sent me. Again same problem. Battery drained very fast. I had 100% 6am and ~60% by 2pm. 02_dense.text: The G6, at least through Tracfone, does not. This difference makes the phone feel disappointingly insubstantial and light. The phone has great functionality, handling every app I throw at it with aplomb. Motorola's gesture support is really fun to use, allowing you to screenshot with a "3-finger salute", flick your wrist to activate your camera, or shake your phone like a Maglite to activate the flashlight. Another difference, weirdly enough, is in the charging ports. The G6 Play uses a USB micro connection, whereas the G6 uses the new "standard" (USB-C) that isn't as common as it likely will be in the future. That means your old micro USB plugs will not work. Sound quality is pretty good, although it could be a tad louder. Motorola tends to have a lot of complaints about faulty sound drivers in their phones, but thankfully this one avoided that curse.

Premium phone, discount price!. I've been using the Moto G6 for a few fays now and I'm impressed. My previous phone was an LG G4. The LG was a bit bigger and a lot more expensive, but I don't notice any appreciable difference in performance. The Moto G6 has much better cell and WiFi reception than the LG. The Moto screen is crisp and clear, and very responsive. All of the apps I used on the LG work flawlessly on the Moto. My only 2 issues so far are that the Moto does not have a user replaceable battery, and there is no easy way to rearrange the navigation buttons on the screen. However, at around $200, versus around a thousand or so for some of those so called flagship phones, I can live with a couple very minor inconveniences.

Had major issues with BOTH phones I bought. I've bought two of these (new) Moto G6 Prime Exclusive phones in 2019 and had issues with them both. Will never buy a third. The first one lasted about 5 months before it started having issues. The screen would start to flash black for a second or two at a time and it would happen a couple of times in a row and then turn itself off. I did a factory reset but the issue still randomly occurs. The second one has a sort of dead "bar" across the screen. As I was installing apps & updates, I noticed that the screen would lag/glitch as I was scrolling through the apps. So I opened the Adobe Acrobat app and set it to freestyle draw so I could test and see if there was a dead spot somewhere.

Touch screen sucks. Hate the touchscreen! If you play Pokemon Go, expect to have to throw you poke ball like a noob as you can't throw curve balls anymore. If you play words with Friends or lexulous, expect to take up to 5 mins to place tiles and make a word. Even when not playing a game, you choose an app to open and it opens the app above the one you picked. WORSE TOUCH SCREEN EVER! The phone does have some great features, but the horrible touchscreen is a deal breaker. Makes the phone so frustrating to use.

Touchscreen goes dead.. I really like the simplicity of this phone. HOWEVER part of the screen does not recognize touch. This started within 6 months after I purchased the phone. It has made the phone partly unusable. I can not transfer my information to a new phone because the screen is dead in the area I need to confirm the transfer. Hmm. My carrier will not do an instore transfer of information.
Screen not bright enough. ...... The phone is a great phone... The only complaint I have is the screen is not bright enough its to dim... I sent it back and waiting for the moto g7 ...

Good for the price. I'll start off by saying that I knew what I was getting for the price. I'm "upgrading" from the Moto X Pure Edition (aka XPE). Long story short, battery was worthless and when I tried replacing it the screen broke. I considered both the G6 and X4, but ultimately bought the G6. Pros: Screen size - I like the 5.7" like the XPE whereas the X4 shrunk to 5.2 Price Performance - i had doubts before but it's definitely enough for me Fingerprint scanner - surprised to see at this price point.
Moto. It is a refurbished phone. And it's really glitchy. It turns off and reboots at least once a day and the screen does freeze.

Good but.... Good phone even after a couple of days(maybe 2 or 3) the touchscreen became unresponsive. not even a factory reset help it. Probably a factory defect. Anybody else had this problem? I had to return it.
Best in picture Quality and fast touchscreen. I love my new phone... great sound, great quality photo. Works good

Performance is very good, Screen looks great. solid build quality, Performance is very good, Screen looks great. Fantastic phone for the price. I bought huawei mate se in same price range but it had several problem like camera, Bluetooth . I am happy with my moto.

Decent. Touch screen is iffy. Sometimes it will work, other times you find yourself violently tapping the screen and wanting to scream. (Dirtx water or any substance on the phone and it won't register) Other than that it's a good phone for the price.
black screen. screen goes black,tapping the screen does not turn it on, happens frequently. I use it for personal use
Defective screen. I received this phone with a defective screen and the seller will not refund or send me a replacement... so I cannot really tell you much about the phone

There is one spot near the top of the screen and one near the bottom of the screen where it is slightly brighter than the rest of the screen. They are about 2-3mm in diameter. It's only annoying when you look for them because then you can't unsee them; however, the vast majority of the time I don't even notice them. The second annoyance is the screen brightness. I don't have an issue during the day, but at night I can't dim the screen enough to make it tolerable in dark rooms. I have the brightness turned all the way down and it still feels like I'm lighting up the entire room. This is especially annoying when I'm trying to get my kids to bed but want to play on my phone. Battery - For normal use the battery appears to last forever.
Screen cracks easily. Positives - great battery life, responsive UI. Negatives - not particularly durable. My screen cracked after a two foot drop onto a carpeted floor.
not purchased. returned sm screen

Screen likes to auto dim to black after 3 secs. I only don't like how the screen keeps auto dimming but then it turns the screen off. I have no idea how to turn it off so if anyone else does let me know please.
